notes.front: Meiosis I of a primary male germ cell produces two secondary spermatocytes.

fields.Text: Meiosis I of a primary male germ cell produces two {{c1::secondary spermatocytes}}.
fields.Extra: Meiose I: 2n, 4C → n, 2C; depois, meiose II → espermátides.

notes.front: Primordial germ cells in the fetal ovary proliferate by mitosis to form oogonia.

fields.Text: Primordial germ cells in the fetal ovary proliferate by mitosis to form {{c1::oogonia}}.
fields.Extra: A janela gestacional exata fica como contexto, não como alvo de repetição.

notes.front: Oogonia that enter meiosis become primary oocytes arrested in prophase I.

fields.Text: Oogonia that enter meiosis become {{c1::primary oocytes}} arrested in prophase I.
fields.Extra: A entrada em meiose, não a simples replicação do DNA, define a transição para ovócito primário.

notes.front: The preovulatory LH surge drives completion of meiosis I, producing a secondary oocyte.

fields.Text: The preovulatory LH surge drives completion of meiosis I, producing a {{c1::secondary oocyte}}.
fields.Extra: A meiose I termina antes da ovulação; o ovócito secundário é ovulado em metáfase II.

notes.front: The developmental fate of primordial germ cells is determined primarily by the gonadal environment.

fields.Text: The developmental fate of primordial germ cells is determined primarily by the {{c1::gonadal environment}}.
fields.Extra: A mesma célula germinativa primordial pode seguir oogênese ou espermatogênese conforme os sinais da gônada.

notes.front: Advanced maternal age increases the risk of meiotic nondisjunction.

fields.Text: Advanced maternal age increases the risk of meiotic {{c1::nondisjunction}}.
fields.Extra: Ovócitos permanecem décadas em prófase I; o envelhecimento enfraquece coesão cromossômica e controle do fuso, favorecendo aneuploidia.

notes.front: Acrosomal exocytosis exposes the inner acrosomal membrane at the sperm head.

fields.Text: Acrosomal exocytosis exposes the {{c1::inner acrosomal membrane}} at the sperm head.
fields.Extra: A membrana plasmática do espermatozoide se funde com a membrana acrossômica externa e libera as enzimas.

notes.front: Binding to zona pellucida glycoproteins triggers sperm acrosomal exocytosis.

fields.Text: Binding to zona pellucida glycoproteins triggers sperm {{c1::acrosomal exocytosis}}.
fields.Extra: Em humanos, ZP1, ZP3 e ZP4 podem participar da indução; tratar ZP3 isolada como o único gatilho é simplificação do modelo clássico.

notes.front: Embryonic cleavage increases cell number without increasing overall embryonic size.

fields.Text: Embryonic cleavage increases cell number without increasing {{c1::overall embryonic size}}.
fields.Extra: A zona pelúcida não se expande; o mesmo volume é repartido em blastômeros progressivamente menores.

notes.front: Neural tube closure normally proceeds bidirectionally from the cervical region.

fields.Text: Neural tube closure normally proceeds {{c1::bidirectionally}} from the cervical region.
fields.Extra: O fechamento avança nos sentidos cranial e caudal, deixando os neuroporos como aberturas temporárias.

notes.front: The urinary and genital systems derive primarily from intermediate mesoderm.

fields.Text: The urinary and genital systems derive primarily from {{c1::intermediate mesoderm}}.
fields.Extra: O mesoderma intermediário forma a crista urogenital, origem dos sistemas urinário e genital.

notes.front: The space between somatic and splanchnic lateral plate mesoderm becomes the intraembryonic coelom.

fields.Text: The space between somatic and splanchnic lateral plate mesoderm becomes the {{c1::intraembryonic coelom}}.
fields.Extra: O celoma intraembrionário origina as cavidades pericárdica, pleurais e peritoneal.

notes.front: From inside out, the three vessel tunics are the intima (endothelium), media (smooth muscle/elastin), and adventitia (connective tissue).

fields.Text: From inside out, the three vessel tunics are the {{c1::intima}} (endothelium), {{c2::media}} (smooth muscle/elastin), and {{c3::adventitia}} (connective tissue).
fields.Extra:
Same plan in every vessel; local pressure sculpts each layer's thickness.

notes.front: Elastic recoil of large arteries maintains forward flow during diastole.

fields.Text: Elastic recoil of large arteries maintains forward flow during {{c1::diastole}}.
fields.Extra: Efeito Windkessel: elastina armazena energia na sístole e a devolve na diástole.

notes.front: Elastic lamellae in an arterial wall are highlighted by the Weigert stain.

fields.Text: Elastic lamellae in an arterial wall are highlighted by the {{c1::Weigert}} stain.
fields.Extra: A coloração torna as lâminas elásticas escuras e facilita distinguir artéria elástica de muscular.

notes.front: The capillary wall is reduced to just endothelium + basal lamina: no media, no adventitia.

fields.Text: The capillary wall is reduced to just {{c1::endothelium + basal lamina}}: no media, no adventitia.
fields.Extra:
Pericytes outside give support and repair.


Image from imported Histology/LLU deck.


Image from imported Histology/LLU deck.

notes.front: Initial lymphatic capillaries admit interstitial fluid through discontinuous button junctions.

fields.Text: Initial lymphatic capillaries admit interstitial fluid through discontinuous {{c1::button junctions}}.
fields.Extra: Abas endoteliais sobrepostas funcionam como microválvulas; filamentos de ancoragem favorecem a abertura com aumento da pressão intersticial.

notes.front: Unlike other CNS glia, microglia derive from the mesodermal monocyte lineage.

fields.Text: Unlike other CNS glia, microglia derive from the {{c1::mesodermal monocyte lineage}}.
fields.Extra: A origem mesodérmica explica sua função como macrófago residente do sistema nervoso central.

fields.Text: In neurons, basophilic cytoplasmic aggregates of rough ER are called {{c1::Nissl bodies}}.

notes.front: Which molecular motor protein is used for anterograde transport along the microtubule? Kinesin

fields.Text:
Which molecular motor protein is used for anterograde transport along the microtubule?

{{c1::Kinesin}}
fields.Extra:
(-) to (+) → i.e., from cell body to axon terminal in neurons

Kinesin "kicks out" (anterograde) and dynein "drags in" (retrograde)

Requires ATP, transports neurotransmitter secretory vesicles to nerve terminals

{{c1::Dynein}}

- Kinesin "kicks out" (anterograde) and dynein "drags in" (retrograde)
- used by Clostridium tetani toxin, poliovirus, rabies virus, HSV

notes.front: Direct bidirectional ion flow through gap junctions characterizes electrical synapses.

fields.Text: Direct bidirectional ion flow through gap junctions characterizes {{c1::electrical synapses}}.
fields.Extra: A transmissão é muito rápida e dispensa liberação de neurotransmissor na fenda.

notes.front: A single oligodendrocyte can myelinate segments of multiple CNS axons.

fields.Text: A single oligodendrocyte can myelinate segments of {{c1::multiple CNS axons}}.
fields.Extra: No SNP, cada célula de Schwann forma um internódio de um único axônio.

notes.front: Each Schwann cell can myelinate one axon(s)

fields.Text: Each Schwann cell can myelinate {{c1::one}} axon(s)
fields.Extra:
- One cell myelinates one internodal segment of a single axon
- SchwaONE

notes.front: Action potentials regenerate at myelin-free gaps called nodes of Ranvier.

fields.Text: Action potentials regenerate at myelin-free gaps called {{c1::nodes of Ranvier}}.
fields.Extra: A alta densidade de canais de Na+ voltagem-dependentes permite condução saltatória entre os nós.

fields.Extra: A célula envolve vários axônios em sulcos, mas não produz a espiral concêntrica da bainha.

notes.front: From superficial to deep, the meninges are dura mater, arachnoid mater, and pia mater.

fields.Text: From superficial to deep, the meninges are {{c1::dura mater}}, {{c1::arachnoid mater}}, and {{c1::pia mater}}.
fields.Extra:
A dura é externa e resistente; a pia acompanha diretamente a superfície do SNC.

notes.front: The T-cell subset that coordinates immune responses through cytokine secretion is the helper T cell.

fields.Text: The T-cell subset that coordinates immune responses through cytokine secretion is the {{c1::helper T cell}}.
fields.Extra: Células T helper (CD4+) organizam outras células por citocinas; não são as únicas células capazes de secretar interleucinas.

notes.front: The organ that filters lymph and receives many afferent but one efferent lymphatic vessel is the lymph node.

fields.Text: The organ that filters lymph and receives many afferent but one efferent lymphatic vessel is the {{c1::lymph node}}.
fields.Extra: A linfa entra pela convexidade, percorre os seios e sai pelo hilo; o baço, em contraste, filtra sangue.

notes.front: B-cell follicles occupy the cortex of a lymph node.

fields.Text: B-cell follicles occupy the {{c1::cortex}} of a lymph node.
fields.Extra: A zona paracortical, dependente do timo, é predominantemente T; os folículos corticais são B.

notes.front: The paracortex is the region of a lymph node between follicles and medulla

fields.Text: The {{c1::paracortex}} is the region of a lymph node between follicles and medulla
